'''Moss-hoppers''' were the tiniest race of [[burrower]]s, rodentlike species which lived throughout the worldwide tundra of [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]]. Moss-hoppers were carnivorous predators which attacked the largest of creatures with their hollow, needle sharp front incisors&mdash;which injected a weak venom into the veins of their prey.
